description: A modern and brand new Luxury Riverside Cabin nestled in the heart of Aguada, just a short distance from some of Rincon and Aguadilla’s world-famous beaches, bars, and restaurants. Featuring breathtaking river and nature views, Casa Naturola is an ideal place to disconnect from life's stressors and enjoy a private space immersed within nature. Casa Naturola has its own private outdoor tub and patio. This is an extraordinary luxury space that you will not want to leave.The spaceCasa Naturola is a Luxury River Cabin with a private outdoor tub, high ceilings and an open-concept area which offers indoor-outdoor living with stunning river views of the Culebra River. The home is ideal for couples.Casa Naturola features an air-conditioned space with a queen bed, a full bathroom, and an outdoor tub. A fully equipped kitchen, indoor and outdoor dining areas and a full sofa bed in the living room complement the space. It also offers wifi, smart tv, and beach essentials, like beach towels and a cooler. Each window has a blackout curtain for optimal privacy during the stay.Grocery stores & shopping are less than five minutes by car.Guest accessYou are welcome to use the entire house, and the yard but please DO NOT go up on the roof or any of the areas identified as prohibited.You can park your vehicle right in front of the house, next to the copper railing.Other things to noteAt this time, Casa Naturola is not equipped with a backup power generator. The property is equipped with a water cistern to provide uninterrupted use of water in the event of an outage. The water heater is high-efficiency and tankless, please allow a few minutes for it to get warm.Help us reduce our carbon footprint by being mindful of your energy consumption. Follow energy conservation practices, like turning off the A/C if you are not using it or closing doors while the A/C is on. For your security, there are outdoor security cameras at the entry access points of the property.The house has tile floors which are slippery when wet. Please dry your feet before entering the house. Apply your sunscreen outside of the house to avoid slippery floors. We also ask that you remove all sunscreen before using the furnishings to avoid stains. Our property has a maximum capacity of 2 guests per stay. Additional guests or visitors are not allowed. During your visit you may encounter some of the Caribbean wildlife that live among us. You may hear coquis (our endemic frog), roosters, horses and may receive the visit of iguanas, as well as some of the cats and dogs from the neighborhood.There are also many opportunities to observe birds like Puerto Rican parrots, Puerto Rican spindalis, red-tail hawks and gray kingbirds.We strive to keep our listing photos as accurate as possible. However, some decorative items, props, seasonal décor, or accessories shown in photos may have been used for staging purposes and may not be available during your stay. The photos are intended to showcase the property’s spaces, layout, and overall guest experience.Decoration for special events, such as anniversaries, birthdays and other events are available for an additional fee.

description: Brand-new modern 2BR/2BA apartment located directly in front of Rincón’s Balneario Beach, steps to the beach. Enjoy a private balcony, stylish décor, full kitchen, fast WiFi, in unit washer and dryer and walking access to town, restaurants, bars, and shops. Enjoy two free parking spaces and a pool. title: Casa Riptides, just magical
description: Your private oceanfront escape in Rincón , Wake up to endless ocean views and end your day watching the most incredible sunsets from your private rooftop. This stunning 6BR/6BA villa sleeps 13 and features a gourmet kitchen, stylish indoor & outdoor living, and premium amenities throughout. Minutes from Rincón’s best restaurants, beaches & surf spots. Stay for the experience.The spaceEscape to Casa Riptides, a stunning three-story oceanfront home in Stella, Rincón, where the days are slow, the sunsets are unforgettable, and the sound of the waves is always in the background.Designed for families, friends, and groups looking to enjoy Rincón together, Casa Riptides gives you the space, comfort, and privacy to truly settle in and enjoy your vacation. From morning coffee overlooking the water to sunset drinks on the rooftop, every level of this home is made for enjoying island life.First FloorSettle into a comfortable living space with a 50” TV, high-speed WiFi, full kitchen, and two air-conditioned bedrooms. You’ll also find three bedrooms, a kitchenette, TV lounge, and laundry area, making this level perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying time together.The RooftopHead upstairs to your own private rooftop escape. With panoramic ocean views, a bedroom, full bathroom, and elegant lounge seating, it’s the perfect spot to sip your morning coffee, watch the waves, or gather for cocktails as the sun goes down.Everything You Need for the BeachWe’ve made beach days easy. Your fully stocked beach lockers include chairs, umbrellas, and coolers, so you can grab what you need and head straight for the sand.And when you’re ready to come home, you’ll have the comfort of secure parking, a 22KW generator, and backup water reserve, so you can relax and enjoy your stay with peace of mind.Come for the ocean. Wake up to breathtaking views, unwind in expansive living spaces, cook with ease in the gourmet kitchen, and retreat to beautifully appointed bedrooms designed for total relaxation.
